integrity: Symbolic cubic determinant and eigenvalue proof; code is reproducibility evidence and not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact for two particles on three periodic sites at arbitrary strictly positive site rates and field in (-1,1); no finite-time distribution equality or larger-ring assertion. A generic cycle-level result may contain an equivalent spectral identity.
title: Exact drive-reversal symmetry of all current fluctuations in a three-site disordered exclusion ring
